title: Explainability and governance (sourcing and tracing)
keyFindings: The suite already implements the talk's 'sourcing and tracing' across its contracts: Astrographer's consistency report + exact-reference resolution (astrographer.md §4.2.3), Zodiac's sourceCrawlId + stale flag (zodiac.md §4.3.2), Familiar's facts provenance + fail-closed validation (familiar.md §4.1.3), Solomon's peerId/instanceType (solomon.md §4.2.2), and Astral's source tool + contentHash (astral.md §4.1) — all already in the specs.

The concrete MUST work is making provenance answer-level: extend Astrographer's ragQuery/ragStream result (astrographer.md §4.3.2) and Zodiac's query result (zodiac.md §4.3.2) with a citations field (the source set the answer is grounded on) and a trace field (the graph path walked) — cheap because the provenance substrate already exists.

A RAG query audit log (who asked what, when, what was returned) is the auditability axis of governance and is a SHOULD addition to astrographer.md §4.3, consistent with D4 (exposable via both GUI and MCP).

Familiar already implements the strongest provenance + audit model in the suite: facts carry provenance {conversation_id, message_id}, the candidate-fact pipeline is fail-closed with machine-actionable rejection reasons, and every accepted/rejected candidate is logged (familiar.md §4.1.3.1).

Explainability is only meaningful if measurable: adopting RAGAS-style faithfulness/answer-relevance metrics (aclanthology.org/2024.eacl-demo.16.pdf) as an evaluation gate is a SHOULD, making the talk's governance point verifiable rather than asserted.

Secondary consumers need little new work: Incanter's per-item provenance (doc_id/chunk_id, incanter.md §4.8) is already in spec; Solomon deep provenance (sourceRef) and Mystery's provenance-carrying crosslink edges are PARKED until their search/crosslink semantics finalize.
summary: Explainability and governance (sourcing and tracing) is not a foreign addition for the Auspicion Suite — the provenance substrate is already in the specs (Astrographer's consistency report and exact-reference resolution, Zodiac's sourceCrawlId, Familiar's facts provenance, Solomon's peerId/instanceType, Astral's contentHash). The concrete MUST/SHOULD work is making provenance answer-level (citation + trace path on RAG results) and auditable (a RAG query audit log), both cheap because the substrate exists, plus RAGAS-style faithfulness/answer-relevance evaluation. This directly answers the source talk's governance point and is consistent with D1 (open-source, auditable), D2 (all local), D3 (provenance flows across the interconnected tools), and D4 (exposable via GUI + MCP).
